title: 3+1D Spin-1/2 point groups: four-data model
scope: The selected E8 section is included through the independently computed H1(G,Z_s). The four data columns are final filtration groups; stacking includes their extensions. Identification of the computed CI kernel with the complete physical theory remains conditional. Reference columns give full interacting classifications, including neutral E8 contributions.
